subject.title: fix: resolve Tavily SecretRefs in agent tools

question: Should this broader PR become the canonical landing for both the Tavily fallback and agent Tool Search runtime-snapshot fixes, superseding https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95110?
rationale: Both branches have credible proof and compatible Tavily logic, but only maintainers can choose whether the agent runtime repair belongs in the same landing or a separate PR.

options.title: Land the broader guarded fix
options.body: Use this PR as the canonical implementation for both failures and retire the narrower Tavily-only candidates after merge.

options.title: Split the agent runtime repair
options.body: Move the Tool Search runtime-config helper and tests into a separate focused PR, then choose the Tavily-only implementation independently.

options.title: Use the narrower Tavily PR
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95110 and pause this PR only if the agent Tool Search repair is separately preserved or intentionally rejected.

recommendation.title: Land the broader guarded fix
recommendation.body: Use this PR as the canonical implementation for both failures and retire the narrower Tavily-only candidates after merge.
